2Check in

SQL Editor → the workshop's warehouse → paste, Run ('DE' for engineers). It shows your Lab 1 schema.

BEGIN
  DECLARE my_schema STRING DEFAULT
      regexp_replace(lower(split_part(current_user(),
      '@', 1)), '[^a-z0-9_]', '_');
  INSERT INTO smbc_workshop.ops.checkin
  SELECT current_user(), 'DA', current_timestamp();
  CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS
      IDENTIFIER('smbc_workshop.' || my_schema);
  SELECT 'smbc_workshop.' || my_schema AS your_schema;
END

Lab 1 · Build the trusted exposure table

  1. + New → Visual data prep, named Monday exposure report; compute Serverless; Preview → All rows. Source: smbc_workshop.bronze.exposure_staging (76,166 rows).
  2. Unique by facility_id, as_of_date, latest extract_ts: 76,166 → 74,757. Guardrails: expressions committed_amount > 0 and maturity_date >= start_date; parent_group_id not null. Failed → Output quarantine_facilities: 474 failed rows.
  3. Aggregate the Passed rows by as_of_date, parent_group_id, group_name, sums named exposure_usd, exposure_jpy. Output gold_group_exposure in your schema (Overwrite) → Run all → Schedule daily, 07:00 Singapore time.

✅ Checkpoint: the two totals should be identical.

SELECT round(sum(exposure_usd) / 1e6, 1) AS mine_usd_m
FROM smbc_workshop.<your_schema>.gold_group_exposure
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-09-30';
SELECT round(sum(exposure_usd) / 1e6, 1)
    AS reference_usd_m
FROM smbc_workshop.gold.group_exposure
WHERE as_of_date = '2026-09-30';

Lab 2 · Credit Committee in 30 seconds

  1. Dashboard: + New → Dashboard on both gold tables. Ask Genie Code for the top-10 bar chart; add counters, a monthly trend and exposure by country; filters; Publish. Then open <workspace URL>/one.
  2. Genie Agent: Genie Agents → New on the same two tables. Title Credit Risk – <your name>, the warehouse you checked in with; add the instructions (A.3), example SQL (A.5) and questions (A.6).
  3. Ask, then open the SQL. Trust, but verify.
  4. Fiscal-year test: ask about Q1 FY2026 and FY2025 and check the dates in the SQL. Add A.4, ask again.

✅ Checkpoint: ask "Which groups were above 90% of their limit at the end of FY2026 H1?", then submit the group's name:

INSERT INTO smbc_workshop.ops.lab_answers
SELECT current_user(), 'lab2', '<group name>',
    current_timestamp();

Genie Code · Ask why, safely

Explore: "Profile smbc_workshop.gold.group_exposure and tell me what is unusual about the latest month compared with April 2026."
Generate: "For the group with the highest utilisation at 30 Sep 2026, split its change in exposure since April into an FX effect and a new-drawdowns effect, by subsidiary. Chart it."
Explain and convert: "Explain this procedure and point out any risks, then rewrite it as Databricks SQL. Just explain first, don't run any code." Paste the legacy procedure from A.9.

Full prompts: workbook A.8, or notebook 03 in the Labs folder.
